description: Representative open PRs, expressed relative to 'now'. Expanded into raw GraphQL nodes by src/sample/expand.ts. PR numbers, authors and content are synthetic.

prs._comment: Highly discussed, limited architectural impact (dashboard frontend).
prs.title: mgr/dashboard: redesign the cluster overview page
prs.author: uidev
prs.body: New landing page layout with capacity and health widgets. Screenshots attached.

reviews.author: rev-a
reviews.body: A few layout issues on narrow screens.

prs._comment: Low discussion, critical BlueStore on-disk metadata path.
prs.title: os/bluestore: encode blob extents compactly in the onode to cut metadata size
prs.author: storagedev
prs.body: Introduces a compact extent encoding for bluestore_blob_t and bumps struct_v. Old onodes are decoded with the previous format; new writes use the compact one. Upgrade path tested with ceph-objectstore-tool. Reduces onode size by ~35% for 4K random-write workloads, which lowers RocksDB write amplification.

prs._comment: Crimson SeaStore cache sharding; modest discussion.
prs.title: crimson/os/seastore: make the LBA cache shard-local and avoid cross-core submit_to
prs.author: crimsondev
prs.body: Each reactor now owns its slice of the extent cache, removing the submit_to hop on the read path.

prs._comment: RocksDB tuning with a measured performance claim.
prs.title: kv/RocksDBStore: tune level compaction for omap-heavy workloads
prs.author: kvdev
prs.body: Changes the default compaction style for the omap column family. In an RGW bucket-index benchmark this gives 30% lower write amplification and better p99 latency.

prs._comment: Multiple subsystems: OSD EC read path + buffer ownership (memory).
prs.title: osd/ECBackend: avoid bufferlist copies on the EC read path and shorten PG lock hold time
prs.author: ecdev
prs.body: Reads now splice shard buffers instead of copying them; ownership of the raw buffers moves to the read op. Lock contention on the PG lock is reduced by completing reads outside the lock.
